speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests; to narrow down the cause, have you noticed any jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes) or changes in your stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) or Autoimmune Hepatitis.

Given your history of ulcerative colitis and the combination of fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver tests, do you have a known autoimmune condition, and have you noticed a rash around your palms or wrists?

REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel (focusing on ALP and GGT).
REQUEST TEST: AMA (Antimitochondrial Antibody).
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound.
